# iosxe_voice_class_media (Resource)

This resource can manage the Voice Class Media configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_voice_class_media" "example" {
  tag           = 1
  anti_trombone = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) Voice class media tag
  - Range: `1`-`10000`

### Optional

- `anti_trombone` (Boolean) Media Anti-trombone functionality
- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `flow` (String) choice of flow case gateway
  - Choices: `flow-around`, `flow-through`
- `forking` (Boolean) Enable media forking
- `monitor_video` (Boolean) Enable video quality monitoring
- `stats_disconnect` (Boolean) Defer BYE for last call stats at disconnect

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_voice_class_media.example "<tag>"
```
